report.timingScope: Measured collection includes feature encoding, all inference and engine work, GRP, branch completion, and optional compressed match persistence including writer drain. Games count actual hanchan completions; hands and LCFR trajectories are separate. Completed decisions count all retained main-game choices, including forced choices; branch work is reported separately. Model load, warmup and post-run observation shape decoding are excluded. The game budget uses the same hanchan unit as Nano, but CFR retains all four seats instead of Nano's learner seat. CollectorStats elapsedSeconds excludes the final writer drain; headline elapsedSeconds includes it.

inputDistribution.selection: First completed .bin files in lexicographic filename order; not a random sample
inputDistribution.scope: Saved main-path decisions from every trajectory and seat; branch outcome metadata is counted but branch inference inputs are not retained
inputDistribution.byteEstimateScope: Canonical uncompressed observation bytes including the CFR header; compact estimate removes only transition padding and excludes any new metadata, object overhead or compression effects; natural bucket sizes are hypothetical regrouping, not measured GPU work
inputDistribution.zeroRunScope: Contiguous structural padding within each transition tensor, merging each action suffix with the following unused action slots; zero-valued real features are retained

inputDistributionProvenance.scope: CPU-only sequential read; no model/GPU; input files unchanged

initialCombinedRocm.note: Grouped test compared dense and frozen policies; BF16 AdamW numerical threshold also exceeded. Neither failure discarded.

v6WithSameNewTests.note: The prior artifact also exceeded dense/frozen policy KL and BF16 AdamW thresholds.

verification.revisedGroupedTest: Use separate-bucket staged policy as the reference; same raw-score and policy thresholds; existing dense/frozen tests retained.

correctedGroupedRocm.note: New grouped policy reference aligned to frozen per-bucket execution. Existing tests and all thresholds unchanged. Raw results retained in target/cfr-100k-20261009/combined-reference-rocm-raw.

compactActionsInitialRocm.note: New compact-action BF16/FP16 policy KL comparisons exceeded thresholds; investigation pending. Raw scores passed.

groupingPrecisionDiagnosis.conclusion: Compact legal actions introduce no further score or policy differences in this fixture. Grouping changes low-precision rounding relative to per-bucket execution. FLOAT32 discrepancy is small, and grouping does not systematically worsen error against FLOAT32. Low-precision policy equivalence to separate buckets is not guaranteed.
groupingPrecisionDiagnosis.limits: One synthetic nonuniform random-head fixture, not trained-model gameplay quality evidence. Original failed comparisons retained.

compactActionsCorrectedRocm.note: Independent shared-state/transition plus dense-candidate reference tests compact candidates only. Fixture and thresholds unchanged. Per-bucket versus grouped rounding difference remains recorded separately.

coalescedRocm.failure: Existing CfrBatchingTest BF16 AVERAGE step 3 relativeL2 0.03088078950916133 exceeded 0.03; cosine 0.9995231344112863. Controlled isolated comparison reproduced the same failure on old and new production JARs. New compact/grouped inference comparisons passed.

finalIsolatedBatchingRocm.scope: Existing BF16 AVERAGE update parity test, step 3. The same failure exists on the old JAR and is not unique to the candidate; this does not rule out other numerical effects. All GPU tests are not green.

freshBuild.note: Fresh isolated package and root repack passed. Only two unused stale generated classes were absent; all current production class bytes match the tested artifact.

kernelProfile.note: Profiler-instrumented runs only; no production JVM setting changed. No kernel bottleneck ranking obtained.

cpuProfileSummary.limitation: Samples are not wall-time attribution; waits exclude intervals below threshold; no batch-size or queue-depth time series was captured; profiled throughput is not a comparative result.
